hud:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create the NEW MODERN ART DIRECTION V2 for Chinese fantasy action game 深渊行者. A premium polished 16:9 landscape actual gameplay screen at high resolution. The user rejected the previous designs as TOO OLD, medieval bronze-carved MMORPG frames. This must look fresh, confident and contemporary, like a beautifully art-directed modern stylized fantasy action RPG.
STYLE: rich vibrant cartoon fantasy, bold chunky character silhouettes, sophisticated warm/cool color harmony, simplified painterly surfaces, clean light and shadow groups. Lush emerald/teal woods with golden sunlight, warm apricot paths, violet shadows and bright cyan magic. Original youthful adventurer with a sweeping short blue cloak and large readable fantasy sword, battling 5 varied adorable-but-dangerous forest creatures. 2.5D isometric game illustration, polished stylized volume, NOT realistic, not pixel art, not gritty, not flat placeholder geometry. World feels alive, with round-canopied trees, grassy path edges, a small sunny camp and a sleek glowing stone gate. Central gameplay remains readable with background detail quieter than actors.
UI V2 LANGUAGE: smooth deep midnight-blue surfaces with a very subtle blue gradient, confident large typography, crisp colorful painted icons, SIMPLE compact silhouettes with softly chamfered corners, delicate warm cream hairline accents and selective apricot/amber focus, minimal material noise, soft controlled depth/shadows. Tiny original four-point compass motif used sparingly. UI should feel bespoke GAME UI, not web dashboard. NO antique bronze scrollwork, NO giant gold/silver frames, NO rivets, NO leather or parchment textures, NO heraldic lions, NO ornate crests, NO huge decorative title plates, NO neon cyberpunk.
LAYOUT: upper-left compact portrait medallion with youthful blue-cloak hero, clean red HP bar '642 / 820' and blue resource bar '280 / 320', name '远行者' small 'Lv. 8'. A lightweight quest tracker just beneath, heading '林地清剿', line '击败林地敌人 3/6', tasteful progress accent, no huge rectangle. Upper-right compact modern circular minimap with thin elegant edge, short title '苍风原野', map markers easy to read. Bottom center FOUR square vivid skill icons with lightly rounded/beveled corners, numbered 1 2 3 4: blue slash, cyan whirlwind, golden shield, emerald healing leaf. Cooldown '2.8' on whirlwind with radial shaded overlay; tiny experience line below. Bottom-left an elegant connected switch '手动' '半自动' '全自动' with apricot filled active 全自动, beneath a small activity pill '正在接敌' with pause icon. Bottom-right four well-drawn modern fantasy pictorial icons with short labels '行囊' '构筑' '目标' '设置'. No ornate tray around every icon. One small currency display '482'. Clear orange ground telegraph, cyan slash arc and golden loot spark in world. Rich color in world and icons, restraint in UI chrome.
Crisp simplified Chinese, large readable labels, no dense small print. Actual usable in-game composition, not a moodboard or presentation. No logo copied from any game, no watermarks. Professional contemporary visual design, beautiful but practical, visually obvious departure from retro MMORPG interfaces.

Use case: ui-mockup design specification board. Create 深渊行者 NEW MODERN UI V2 component sheet matching reference exactly in clean modern fantasy UI styling. 16:9 high resolution landscape. Background solid midnight blue, six zones in organized two-column three-row layout, separated by quiet lines and whitespace, no world scene. Title '深渊行者 · 现代奇幻 UI' and small subtitle '浓郁色彩 · 轻量界面 · 清晰交互'. Bold crisp simplified Chinese labels. Soft rounded/chamfered silhouettes, subtle cream outlines, rich painted icon colors, selective APRICOT GOLD selection and primary action. NO heavy metallic frames, no bronze carvings, no leather, no parchment, no rivets, no antique style, no sci-fi neon.
Zone 1 '颜色与表面': midnight blue, slate blue, warm cream, apricot gold, cyan magic, coral danger swatches. Smooth matte UI surface samples, no noisy textures.
Zone 2 '按钮状态': SAME '装备' button in default apricot filled, hover slightly brighter, pressed darker inset, disabled muted readable; captions '默认' '悬停' '按下' '禁用'. Secondary '取消', danger '分解'. Modern clean geometry, not thick decorative edges.
